# pytscheck verification audit — 2026-10-12

Base commit: `e691879f024a8037c1b40ce701f74ef23335b005`. Python 3.12. All commands use the existing `.[dev]` dependencies installed in `/tmp/pytscheck-audit-env`; no dependencies were added.

## Summary
Files touched: 159
Bugs fixed in src/: 14 grouped issues
Bugs fixed in tests/: 14 grouped issues
Bugs fixed in benchmarks/: 4 grouped issues
Tests added: 19 collected cases
Public function/model/exception API changes: none

Counts group related root causes, exclude formatting-only edits, and separate packaging fixes from src/test/benchmark counts. Most touched files needed the requested Ruff formatting/import cleanup.

## Failures found and fixed

| ID | Failure | Class | Fix / touches |
|---|---|---|---|
| S01 | Adapter circular import | bug-in-src | adapters/base.py imports SourceFile from models |
| S02 | Mypy implicit constant re-export | bug-in-src | resolver.py imports TSCONFIG_FILENAME from defaults |
| S03 | Missing Darwin architecture aliases | bug-in-src | runner.py adds amd64/aarch64 aliases |
| S04 | Invalid adapter name/callable accepted | bug-in-src | adapters/registry.py validates string names and callable get_sources |
| S05 | Invalid/escaping virtual source paths accepted | bug-in-src | adapters/sources.py rejects non-string, absolute, drive, traversal and NUL paths |
| S06 | Unicode configuration errors leak | bug-in-src | config.py wraps UnicodeError as ConfigurationError |
| S07 | Deep JSON recursion leaks | bug-in-src | config.py wraps RecursionError as ConfigurationError |
| S08 | Symlink-resolution failures leak RuntimeError | bug-in-src | paths.py wraps normalization failures; checker uses normalize |
| S09 | NUL extends path leaks ValueError | bug-in-src | resolver.py validates NUL and normalizes paths |
| S10 | Internal source checker misses NUL validation | bug-in-src | checker.py validates source and filename before writes |
| S11 | Project paths are not normalized | bug-in-src | config.py normalizes validate_project_root input |
| S12 | Empty option values silently ignored | bug-in-src | options.py distinguishes None from empty strings |
| S13 | Abnormal or warning-only nonzero exits become Results | bug-in-src | checker.py raises CompilerExecutionError and retains stdout/stderr/returncode |
| S14 | Project configuration / extraction boundary gaps | bug-in-src | checker validates project extends before execution; resolver preserves project JSONC; api.py wraps unexpected extraction errors as AdapterExtractionError |
| T01 | tests helper package cannot import | bug-in-tests | tests/__init__.py |
| T02 | Two helpers incorrectly indented | bug-in-tests | tests/helpers.py |
| T03 | Import test corrupts exception identities | bug-in-tests | unit/test_api_contracts.py uses an isolated interpreter and audit hook |
| T04 | Compiler-dependent tests lack binary fixture | bug-in-tests | compatibility/test_linux.py, security/test_untrusted_config.py, test_error_recovery.py |
| T05 | Protocol test assumes runtime type validation | bug-in-tests | adapters/test_protocol.py exercises actual registration rejection |
| T06 | Dataclass hashing/copying assertions contradict stdlib behavior | bug-in-tests | unit/test_config_merging.py retains existing CompilerOptions semantics |
| T07 | Exception slot test incorrectly assumes no inherited dictionary | bug-in-tests | test_exceptions.py verifies payload slots without changing exception semantics |
| T08 | SystemExit assertion calls helper which captures it | bug-in-tests | test_cli.py and test_exit_codes.py call real main directly |
| T09 | Timeout output is buffered | bug-in-tests | test_process_timeout.py flushes the subprocess output |
| T10 | Valid single-line fuzz data contains line separators | bug-in-tests | fuzz/test_diagnostic_parser.py fixes generator alphabet without weakening assertions |
| T11 | Hypothesis fixture health checks prevent examples | bug-in-tests | fuzz/test_random_configs.py documents safe complete-file overwrite |
| T12 | License test requests another module’s fixture | bug-in-tests | test_license_metadata.py uses repository fixture and actual TOML |
| T13 | Undefined checker reference | bug-in-tests | test_windows_paths.py imports the real checker |
| T14 | Blind exception assertions permit false positives | bug-in-tests | tests narrow raised/suppressed exceptions to the library taxonomy; literal path regex escaped |
| B01 | Dynamic module loader breaks dataclasses | bug-in-benchmarks | run.py registers module before executing it and cleans up failed imports |
| B02 | Rates compared in wrong direction | bug-in-benchmarks | run.py treats throughput/speedup/efficiency increases as improvements |
| B03 | Malformed/error benchmark results reported as success | bug-in-benchmarks | run.py rejects non-dictionary results and nested errors |
| B04 | Cold-import failures become negative timings | bug-in-benchmarks | startup.py raises explicit errors rather than returning -1 |
| P01 | Duplicate wheel inclusion breaks builds | tooling-config | Approved pyproject.toml change removes redundant force-include |
| P02 | Console entry point absent | tooling-config | Approved pyproject.toml declares pytscheck.__main__:main |
| P03 | Root compiler notices absent | tooling-config | Approved NOTICE.txt retains original bundled compiler notices |
| E01 | Bundled native compiler absent | environment | No compiler measurements; compiler-dependent tests skip explicitly |
| Q01 | 217 Ruff findings / 151 files need formatting | tooling-config | Fix reported issues; preserve public export group order with explained local RUF022 suppression |
| Q02 | Unsafe platform mocks in existing tests | bug-in-tests | Use actual unsupported-platform checks; supported platforms explicitly skip instead of mocking |
| Q03 | Postponed annotation spelling changed by formatter | missing-coverage | Restore exact public annotation and add regression; explained local UP037 suppression |

## Improvements proposed (not applied)

### Correctness holes

```text
File: src/pytscheck/runner.py:102–124
Current: capture_output=True; size limits checked after completion
Problem: Unbounded process output can consume memory before the limit is checked.
Proposed: Bound output capture during execution.
Test to add: A real executable emits output continuously.
Risk: Timeout/cleanup and Windows behavior.
```

### Dead code

```text
File: src/pytscheck/client.py:29
Current: runner: RunnerFn | None = None
Problem: Client methods never use this field.
Proposed: Retain the public field; document its inactivity pending a separately approved backend design.
Test to add: Verify the documented behavior without mocking compiler/runner.
Risk: Users may expect injection that was never implemented.
```

### Duplication with drift risk

```text
File: src/pytscheck/api.py and checker.py — source validation
Current: Separate NUL validation paths
Problem: One rejected NUL input while the other previously did not.
Proposed: Share validation after both entry-point contracts are specified.
Test to add: Identical invalid inputs through both entry points.
Risk: Public and internal filename handling differ.
```

### Type holes

```text
File: benchmarks/run.py — BenchmarkResult.data
Current: data: dict
Problem: Payload shapes, missing/non-finite metrics are not fully typed/validated.
Proposed: Define internal metric types and validate missing/non-finite values.
Test to add: Missing, NaN, infinity and negative timings.
Risk: Baseline migration; avoid mistaking counters for timings.
```

### Docstrings

```text
File: src/pytscheck/adapters/source_maps.py:22–45
Current: Rewrite diagnostic file/line/column; actual code changes file only
Problem: Generated coordinates can be mistaken for original source coordinates.
Proposed: Document the identity-position limitation, then design VLQ support separately.
Test to add: A source map with a nonzero line offset.
Risk: Full mapping changes locations consumers depend on.
```

## What I did not do

- Did not install/download or commit native compiler binaries, use compiler mocks, or report fake performance numbers.
- Did not change version constants, public function signatures, model fields or exception names/parent relationships.
- Did not add dependencies, delete tests, or apply Phase 6 proposals.
- Did not edit scripts/, conformance/, or GitHub workflows; their broader checks are outside this scoped audit.
- Did not claim compiler accuracy, cross-platform execution, compiler benchmarks, or full CI release readiness.
- Outside the original three-directory scope: only approved pyproject.toml and NOTICE.txt packaging changes.
